title: The First Variable in Ten Thousand Years
next_chapter_hook: When the Axis of Fate begins to turn, the old chess game has already collapsed. New rules are being reshaped, and those chess players hidden in the shadows are about to reveal their true fangs.

text.content: The solidification of the simulation space was like amber frozen in time, and that fourth figure was slowly approaching from the end of the timeline. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—he saw Su Qingyao, he saw Chen Nian, but he did not foresee this figure itself. What did this mean? It meant this existence transcended the calculations of the Tianji Record, transcended the predetermined trajectory of the River of Fate.

dialogue.content: (The voice was like an ancient bell, yet rippling through the void) 'The first existence in ten thousand years to surprise me.' The figure finally revealed its true form—it was a pair of eyes, vertical pupils like an abyss, gazing at Chen Ji as if examining a chess piece that had finally escaped the board, 'Chen Ji... no, perhaps I should use a different name. You are the "Variable".'

text.content: Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of oppression. That was not the crushing weight of spiritual power, but rather the instinctive俯瞰 from a higher-dimensional existence gazing upon lower-dimensional life. Su Qingyao and Chen Nian's figures were frozen on either side, their threads of destiny like frozen spider silk, and he—Chen Ji standing before this fourth figure—had become the only variable in this solidified space.

dialogue.content: (A faint smile curled at the corner of his lips, a smile containing no fear, only a composure that saw through the entire chess game) 'Surprise? The ten thousand year chess game you've arranged, Heavenly Secrets Eye, has finally produced its first piece you cannot see through. This must be quite uncomfortable for you, right?'

text.content: A barely perceptible fluctuation flashed through those abyssal vertical pupils. Throughout ten thousand years, no existence had ever dared speak to it in such a tone. Even those supreme experts who called themselves 'Heaven-defiers', when faced with the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, had never displayed such tranquility—that very tranquility was the greatest blasphemy.

dialogue.content: (The void trembled, and the figure slightly bent forward, as if re-examining Chen Ji) 'Interesting. For ten thousand years, I have offered three paths—Following Heaven, Modifying Heaven, Defying Heaven.' Countless brilliant talents had chosen one among them. The vertical pupils flickered with light, 'And you, Chen Ji, have chosen a path that has never existed. Tell me, what is your fourth path?'

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward. That one step shattered the shackles of temporal solidification, shattered the predetermined trajectory of fate. He felt the Tianji Record violently trembling in his Mental Sea, as if those incomplete pages wished to break free and glimpse higher-dimensional truths—but it could not, because the existence before him was itself a forbidden zone beyond the Tianji Record's calculative reach.

dialogue.content: (His voice was clear and resonant, yet carrying undeniable resolve) 'Those who follow Heaven become Heaven's hounds; those who modify Heaven become usurpers of destiny; those who defy Heaven ultimately become incarnations of Heaven's tools. Three paths, three endings, all within your calculations.' He raised his head,直视 those abyssal vertical pupils, 'And my fourth path—'

text.content: Chen Ji's momentum peaked at this moment. He was no longer thattrash disciple who needed to hide his strength, no longer that chess piece struggling within the Tianji Record's framework. He was—the fourth type of existence.

choices.visible_cost: Requiring massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value to break through rule boundaries
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the 'Game Rewriter' identity, unlocking new functions in the Tianji Record

text.content: The Tianji Record's fragments trembled violently in his Mental Sea, as if sensing the unprecedented act their master was about to perform. New possibilities were opening, while old rules were崩裂.

choices.description: Proposing an equal cooperative relationship with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets without being servile or overbearing, not a master-servant relationship, but jointly exploring possibilities beyond existing dimensions.
choices.visible_cost: Requiring demonstration of sufficient筹码 and sincerity

text.content: Chen Ji's proposal was extraordinarily bold—to stand as an equal to Heaven's will with a mortal body. Throughout ten thousand years, no one had ever dared propose such acrazed的 idea.

dialogue.content: (His voice was like thunder, exploding in the solidified space) 'I will not break your rules, because breaking itself remains within rules; I will not take your position, because taking is merely another cycle of reincarnation.' Chen Ji spread his arms open, as if embracing the entire void, 'What I will do is rewrite this chess game itself. Let Heaven, from a player become part of the chessboard.'

text.content: The simulation space shook violently. In those abyssal vertical pupils, genuine emotional fluctuation finally emerged—not anger, not contempt, but... recognition. Throughout ten thousand years, countless talents had left their marks on the three paths, and today, someone finally stood at the starting point of the fourth path.

dialogue.content: (That voice carried an indescribable meaning) 'Interesting. The first true variable in ten thousand years.' The abyss within those vertical pupils seemed to deepen, 'Since you wish to rewrite the rules... let me see, do you have the qualifications?' Before the words even finished, the entire simulation space abruptly cracked open a fissure, revealing the endless starry seas and reincarnations beyond—那就是命运之轴的真容.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a torrential force gush from that fissure. That was the power of the Axis of Fate—the supreme law determining all beings' trajectories since ancient times. The moment this force touched him, the Tianji Record abruptly let out a mournful cry, as if mourning for the impending judgment. Yet Chen Ji did not retreat; his eyes，反而爆发出前所未有的光芒.

dialogue.content: (A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips, containing no luck, only absolute confidence) 'The Axis of Fate? Good.' Chen Ji raised his right hand, and on his palm appeared a light pattern condensed from pure heavenly principles, 'Since you wish to test me, then let you see—how does a true variable make predetermined fate flow once more?'

text.content: The moment the Axis of Fate's light touched Chen Ji, the entire simulation space trembled. Yet that trembling was not because Chen Ji was being crushed—rather, the Axis of Fate itself was being rewritten by some force. Those predetermined trajectories carved on the axis began to blur, dissolve, reshape, like a river forcibly diverted, carving new channels under Chen Ji's will.

dialogue.content: (In those vertical pupils, genuine fluctuation finally emerged—surprise, shock, the first emotional起伏 in ten thousand years) 'You... actually did it.' The voice carried a complex meaning, 'Rule Rewriter... no, not just that. You are the first existence in ten thousand years to cause deviation in my calculations.'

text.content: Chen Ji's spine stood perfectly straight, that neither servile nor overbearing momentum made even the Eye of Heavenly Secrets take notice. Throughout ten thousand years, no mortal had ever dared to declare independence so unapologetically before it.

dialogue.content: (Those abyssal vertical pupils slowly closed, then slowly opened, as if engaged in profound contemplation) 'Interesting. For the first time in ten thousand years, I encounter an existence I wish to treat with 'cooperation' rather than 'use'.' The voice carried unprecedented solemnity, 'Chen Ji, I have a proposal—not master and servant, not exploitation, but true cooperation. What say you?'

text.content: Chen Ji felt the power of the Axis of Fate flowing through his body, and that originally cold axis wheel was now slightly warm, as if transmitting some signal to him. The Tianji Record's fragments unfurled in his Mental Sea, revealing a corner of content he had never seen—那是关于维度本源的记载, an existence transcending the Tianji Record itself. Chen Nian's figure, shadowy and indistinct in that light, seemed waiting for his summons.

dialogue.content: (His gaze swept over Su Qingyao and Chen Nian's still figures, finally fixing on those abyssal vertical pupils) 'Cooperation?' He laughed lightly, that smile containing mockery,scrutinizing, and a通透 seeing through everything, 'Good. I accept. But remember—I accept equal cooperation, not subservient handouts.' He stepped forward, momentum soaring like a rainbow, 'This chess game has just begun. And from today onward, there is more than one player on the chessboard.'

text.content: The simulation space collapsed completely. Under Chen Ji's will, the Axis of Fate began to be recast. Those ancient laws carved on the axis were stripped away one by one, replaced by brand-new trajectories—a path of destiny personally painted by Chen Ji. When the final light dissipated, Chen Ji found himself still standing in place, yet everything around him had changed. Su Qingyao and Chen Nian's figures could finally move, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice lingered in the void—'The ancient chess game, new chapter begins. Chen Ji, let me see how far you can go.'

When Chen Ji opened his eyes, he found himself still standing in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. Su Qingyao was gazing at him with worry, her eyes slightly red, as if she had endured endless anxiety during his absence. Further away, Chen Nian's figure was shadowy in the mist, that blurred outline seemingly ready to dissipate at any moment. Chen Ji felt the newborn power within him—那是规则重写者独有的印记, the first mark he had carved on the Axis of Fate. The Tianji Record trembled gently in his Mental Sea, as if congratulating its true master on finally stepping onto a journey beyond fate.
